hero.tagline: Parallel development for the agent era.
hero.subtitle: A Mac-native workspace that turns git worktrees and terminals into a cockpit for many agents.
hero.footnote: Apple Silicon · macOS 14+ · Free & open source

matrix.title: Many agents. One cockpit.
matrix.lead: Sixteen worktrees, sixteen agents, one window. Each pane runs its own session — claude, codex, tests, a dev server — and you keep them in your peripheral vision the way a pilot reads instruments.
matrix.hint: Hover any tile to isolate it.

hierarchy.title: From repo to pane in one move.
hierarchy.lead: Project → Worktree → Tab → Pane. A four-level hierarchy that maps directly onto how you already think about parallel work, with one keystroke between any two levels.

worktree.title: Worktrees, weaponized.
worktree.lead: Spin up a worktree per task in a single command. Each one gets its own filesystem, its own terminal, its own agent — diverging from main and merging back without ever stashing or context-switching the repo.

cli.title: Drive it from any terminal.
cli.lead: The app speaks JSON-RPC over a local Unix socket. Inspect the hierarchy, spawn panes, send keystrokes, read back rendered output, broadcast across panes — every interaction the GUI exposes is a one-liner away.

native.title: Native, fast, quiet.
native.lead: Built on libghostty for terminals you can actually feel. Swift 6 with strict concurrency. Tuned for Apple Silicon. Nothing between you and the bytes.

cta.title: Get touch-code.
cta.sub: One drag into /Applications. The tc shim installs itself on first launch.
